guardrails.name: delta_band_usd

guardrails.name: cost_budget_bps

guardrails.name: kill_switch_max_drawdown

guardrails.name: kill_switch_toxicity

guardrails.name: kill_switch_cost_bps
guardrails.rationale: Kill-switch: halt paper deployment if effective cost exceeds 5.00 bps of traded notional; observed 1.06 bps.

guardrails.name: max_daily_loss_usd
guardrails.rationale: Daily loss limit 50,000 USD from .env.example risk limits; paper-only bound, checked against realized PnL at deployment time.

guardrails.name: live_trading_disabled
guardrails.rationale: Live trading disabled (LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED=false); EVAL-13 certification is paper-only and does not authorize deployment or venue connectivity.
